results.title: Nigerian priest rescued after being kidnapped
results.snippet:
Priests are being increasingly targeted in Nigeria, with the diocese of Otukpo suffering another incident when a seminarian escaped his captors after being held for more than two weeks.

Cardinal John Onaiyekan, Archbishop Emeritus of Abuja, urged the Nigerian government to take measures to put an end to kidnappings.
